about: The one table of Bose software SoundTap installs from, read by install.sh, install.ps1 and index.html. A rule matches the <type> of the speaker's :8090/info exactly (typeContains: as a substring) and, when it names one, its <moduleType>. minimum is the oldest Bose software with a recorded install on that model (docs/owners/install.md); versions compare number by number. Unsupported rules are checked first, so a SoundTouch 20 that reports the Series III's sm2 module never reaches the Series I/II rule; a speaker no rule matches is not supported either. Keep one rule per line: install.sh reads it line by line.
